raw.query: SELECT run_id, v_dim.window_name, p99_ms FROM provenance.v_dim JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency USING (run_id) WHERE v_dim.is_current AND run_id IN ('sweeps:llm_burst1_poly_s1', 'sweeps:llm_burst1_aic_s1') AND sla_metric = 'ttft';
raw.observed: sweeps:llm_burst1_poly_s1 = 910.33 ms (8.97% under 1000 ms SLA bound); sweeps:llm_burst1_aic_s1 = 1868.03 ms
raw.claimed: Polynomial: 910 ms TTFT p99 (9% under bound); AIC: 1868 ms TTFT p99
raw.evidence: Polynomial run sweeps:llm_burst1_poly_s1 achieved 910.33 ms TTFT p99 while AIC run sweeps:llm_burst1_aic_s1 achieved 1868.03 ms TTFT p99 on the burst1 window. Additionally, frames-class requests with median context of 33,722 tokens create a prefill floor of ~1285 ms at TP1 that persists through 16 worker replicas.
